problems.problem: Wrong publication year for Kiran Nagarkar's Cuckold; it was published in 1997, not 1995.
problems.verifierReason: Cuckold first published by Penguin India in 1997; won Sahitya Akademi Award 2000.

problems.quote: which might require post-processing heat treatment (Thermal processing) not needed in traditional casting
problems.problem: Investment casting of turbine blades (e.g., Ni-based superalloys) requires extensive heat treatment (solutionizing, aging, HIP) for microstructure control; it is false that traditional casting avoids heat treatment.
problems.correction: which might require post-processing heat treatment (Thermal processing) similar to or more extensive than traditional casting
problems.verifierReason: Original falsely claims traditional casting avoids heat treatment; Ni-based superalloys require extensive heat treatment regardless of casting method.

problems.quote: σ_θ(r) = E α / (1 − ν) · [ (1/r²) ∫₀ʳ T(ρ) ρ dρ + ν ∫ʳᴿ T(ρ) ρ dρ / (R² − r²) ]
problems.problem: Formula uses solid-cylinder limits (0, R) and an erroneous term ν∫ʳᴿ/(R²−r²) for a hollow heat-exchanger tube; correct hollow-cylinder formulation uses inner/outer radii r_i, r_o and denominator (r_o²−r_i²).
problems.correction: σ_θ(r) = Eα/(1−ν)[(1/r²)∫_{r_i}^r Tρ dρ + (1/(r_o²−r_i²))∫_{r_i}^{r_o} Tρ dρ (1+r_i²/r²) − T(r)]
problems.verifierReason: Original uses solid-cylinder limits and incorrect ν term; proposed correction matches standard hollow-cylinder thermal stress formula (Timoshenko & Goodier).
